messages.text: It's time! Championship, League One and League Two opening day LIVE!
Clayton clinches title in Auckland with HUGE bullseye finish!

metadata.summary: Jonny Clayton clinched the New Zealand Darts Masters with this huge bullseye finish to beat Gerwyn Price!

messages.text: Hole-in-one alert! Schmid makes ace at FedEx St. Jude Championship

metadata.summary: In the second round of the FedEx St. Jude, Matti Schmid's 173-yard tee shot on the par-3 fourth hole went in for his first career hole-in-one.

messages.text: Live on Sky: Watford vs Southampton & Burnley vs West Ham
Sound up! 🔊 Walter unfazed by emergency alert!

metadata.summary: Paul Walter was left unfazed by the sounds of the government's emergency alert as he hit a huge six in The Hundred on Friday.

messages.text: PSG sign World Cup final hero Torres from Barcelona

metadata.summary: PSG have completed the signing of Spain's World Cup final hero Ferran Torres from Barcelona for £42.7m.

messages.text: Championship play-off changes, new managers & star players - the EFL is BACK!

metadata.summary: Tottenham captain Cristian Romero has completed his £34.2m move to Atletico Madrid.
